subject: Next steps & pilot scaffold — Westbridge discovery recap

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Next steps & pilot scaffold — Westbridge discovery recap

Hi Kelly —

Thanks again for a great call today. Quick recap and proposed pilot scaffold so we can align on scope and owners before kickoff. TL;DR: confirm dataset access + 2 success metrics, 6-week pilot, Redwood provides prompt set + eval harness.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Pain: Care coordination notes are inconsistent across clinics; triage team spends 18–25 min per patient reconciling records.
- Goal: Reduce triage summarization time by ~50% and surface top-3 recommended next actions with >=85% precision vs. clinician review.
- Security: PHI cannot leave VPC during the pilot; we need SOC2 evidence and an access plan for SFTP ingestion.

Proposed pilot scope (6 weeks)
1) Data: 4 weeks of anonymized triage notes (SFTP to VPC) + sample EHR JSON schema.
2) Model surface: 1 LLM variant hosted in your private VPC + a smaller quantized variant for burst testing.
3) Deliverables: prompt suite (10 templates), evaluation harness (precision/recall for actions), weekly telemetry dashboard, and a final acceptance report.

Success metrics
- Primary: reduce manual triage time by >=40% (measured via time-on-task A/B).
- Secondary: action recommendation precision >=85% on a clinician-labeled 200-case eval set.
- Ops: average inference latency <750ms p95 for 256-token responses.

Owners & roles
- Westbridge: Kelly Torres (pilot sponsor), Rizwan Ahmed (data/infra lead), (procurement TBD).
- Redwood: Ben Carter (engagement lead), Grace O'Connor (implementation/ops), Jordan Blake (prompt & eval lead).

Immediate asks (next 7 days)
- Westbridge: confirm SFTP endpoint and point-of-contact for data transfer (Rizwan?) — target by Fri Feb 13.
- Westbridge: confirm PO/procurement cadence or estimate for MSA review.
- Redwood: circulate pilot charter + example prompt set (attached) and SOC2 snapshot (attached).

Attachments: WB-pilot-charter-draft.pdf, example-prompt-set.csv, Westbridge_Security_QA.xlsx

If this looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for the week of Feb 16 and include the engineering owners. Happy to adjust scope if the procurement window is longer.

Thanks —
Ben Carter

Ben — quick internal note (copying Kelly so she has visibility). A couple of operational clarifications before kickoff:
- We’ll need an AWS account ID for the VPC peering and a short-lived IAM role for the ingestion agent.
- For the latency SLO, can we get a sense of average sequence lengths? If most notes are <200 tokens we can tighten p95 easily.
- Jordan: I’ll hand off prompt/eval coordination to you once the charter is finalized.

Thanks —
